app.lema: Proof of learning, not just proof of delivery.
app.descripcion: A study companion that plans your week, teaches you without doing your homework, and asks you to explain what you submitted.

pasos.organizaDetalle: Every assignment comes with difficulty, time estimate and priority.
pasos.aprendeDetalle: The tutor guides you with questions and hints, never with the answer.
pasos.demuestraDetalle: After you submit, explain your work by voice or text.

cuaderno.etiqueta: Example: assignment submitted as a notebook photo
cuaderno.pregunta: On line 2 you subtracted 5 on both sides. Why on both?
cuaderno.respuesta: So the equation stays equal: whatever I do on one side I do on the other.

docente.texto: Not just who submitted, but who understood. A map by student and concept, plus the topics the class needs to review.
